meta.title: Native taskbar number badge
meta.description: Windows native per-session unread-result count. Only the active, visible Chat result footer acknowledges its exact revision; foreground results still count. No toast, sound or focus stealing.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable the Windows helper. Disabling clears the overlay and stops the helper.

desktopExecutable.title: DSH Desktop executable (Windows)
desktopExecutable.description: Absolute Windows path to the exact DSH desktop .exe. Empty: use DSH_DESKTOP_EXECUTABLE, the current DSH executable or the packaged Host location. No title guessing.

pythonPath.title: Python executable (Windows)
pythonPath.description: Absolute Windows path to an existing python.exe (Python 3.10+). Empty: use DSH_PYTHON_PATH, DSH_HOME's official primary runtime or the desktop-bundled Python. Never uses Electron or installs Python.

notifyOnError.title: Count unsuccessful endings
notifyOnError.description: Include errors, blocked turns and token-limit endings, but not user cancellation or history markers.

notifyOnWaiting.title: Count input requests
notifyOnWaiting.description: Include unresolved approvals and ask_user_question until answered/decided. Viewing alone does not acknowledge pending requests. Multiple requests in one main session count once.

notifyOnGoalRounds.title: Count intermediate goal rounds
notifyOnGoalRounds.description: Off by default: completed rounds of an active automatically continuing goal are suppressed. Final goal completion and failures can still count.

language.title: Diagnostic language
language.description: Defaults to Simplified Chinese (zh); en and explicit auto remain available. Auto reads LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES, then LANG; absent/unsupported languages fall back to Simplified Chinese. Settings metadata follows a supported host UI language, otherwise Chinese.
